exports: pub fn quote_masks(quote_mask: u64, backslash_mask: u64, valid_len: u8, carry: &mut ScanCarry) -> Result<QuoteMasks>

unsafe_justifications.justification: No unsafe code or architecture intrinsics are used. The frozen contract permits portable bit operations on the combined masks produced by NEON classification. Backslash-run traversal and six prefix-XOR steps resolve all four lanes together without additional CPU feature requirements, allocation, or dependencies. All variable shifts are bounded below 64; runs ending at position 64 are handled explicitly.

test_vectors: Exact expected masks and outgoing carry for empty input, adjacent delimiters, ordinary string content, escaped quotes inside and outside strings, even backslash runs, and unfinished strings with trailing escapes.
Empty input under all four canonical quote-carry states, including fully overlapping padded masks, preserves all carry fields.
Exhaustive sequences of length zero through eight over ordinary bytes, quotes, and backslashes, under all four incoming states, compared with an independent byte-state oracle.
Every backslash-run length before every quote position from zero through 63, tested as both a partial block and a full block with all incoming states.
Every valid length zero through 64 for uniform ordinary, quote, backslash, control, and non-ASCII blocks; explicit outgoing parity assertions for all-backslash inputs.
Incoming escape consumption by a quote, ordinary byte, control byte, non-ASCII byte, or continued backslash run.
Dirty overlapping padding above every valid length is ignored, every output mask is clipped, and a final actual backslash retains its carry despite padding.
Exact bit-63 and full-width prefix vectors, including escaped quotes at bit 63 and all-quote blocks.
Every split from zero through 64 recombines to continuous oracle masks and carry, with inserted empty blocks and quotes around all three 16-byte lane boundaries.
Two full blocks with every trailing run length zero through 64 and every next-block leading run length zero through 63, under all four incoming states.
128 deterministic xorshift-generated mixed blocks, every valid prefix length, and every canonical incoming state compared with the independent oracle.
Every invalid u8 length from 65 through 255 returns InvalidToken before carry or overlap validation, with Scanner source, zero offset, and unchanged carry.
Noncanonical carry values 2, 3, 255, 256, 2^32, 2^63, and u64::MAX in either or both quote fields return InternalError at every valid length without mutation.
Quote/backslash overlap at every live position of every nonempty valid length returns InternalError transactionally under all four incoming states.
Every UTF-8 tail length zero through 255, including invalid UTF-8 metadata, remains byte-for-byte unchanged on empty success, nonempty success, and error.
